title: Where did my documents actually go?
description: Shows that filing is sane and findable: open Search, find a filed document, open its page, and read off the folder structure and filename from the details ScanFinder extracted — the issuer becomes the folder, the date the year and month, and the type and reference the file name (e.g. Invoice.15-12-2025.INV-001.pdf under Company/Year/Month). Fully in-app; no native folder picker is opened. Searches 'Ironbridge' — the sandbox has one confirmed/filed Ironbridge Fabrication invoice (Search only returns confirmed documents), so there is exactly one clean result.

steps.narration: When Scan Finder files a document, where does it actually end up? In tidy folders you'll never have to dig through, because Search finds anything instantly.
steps.caption: Where your filed documents live

steps.narration: Type something printed on the document — here, the sender's name.
steps.caption: 2. Search for a filed document

steps.narration: Open a result and the filed page appears, exactly as it was scanned.
steps.caption: 4. Open a result

steps.narration: These details decide everything. The issuer becomes the folder, the date sets the year and month, and the type and reference make the file name.
steps.caption: Issuer, date, reference → the filing

steps.narration: So this one sits under its company, then the year, then the month, with a clear name built from the type, the date and the reference number.
steps.caption: Company / Year / Month · clear filename

steps.narration: You never have to remember any of that. Type a word, open the page, done.
steps.caption: Never dig through folders

steps.narration: That's where your documents go — findable in seconds, every time.
steps.caption: Findable in seconds
